## netmera.com
Netmera is an AI-powered customer data and engagement platform. It gives marketing, CX, and product teams the tools to collect customer data, run personalized campaigns across every digital channel, and measure the results, without routing every task through IT. 
The platform combines three capabilities that are often handled by separate tools: 1) Customer data ingestion and collection 2) Omnichannel campaign execution 3) Analytics and reporting

Reach every customer with 
AI that never slows down
 
 
 
One platform for unified data, automated cross-channel journeys, and real-time analytics. AI predicts, creates, and acts so marketing, CX, and product teams reduce churn, grow revenue, and personalize every interaction.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
See Success Stories

Overall Score

Everything your team needs for engagement & growth. 
In one place.
 
 
 
Customer data comes in, decisions happen, campaigns run, through the core capabilities teams use every day.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Data Management 
 
 
 
 Analytics 
 
 
 
 Journeys 
 
 
 
 Segmentation 
 
 
 
 Personalization 
 
 
 
 Omnichannel Messaging 
 
 
 
 
AI
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Data Management
 
 
The built-in CDP collects data from mobile apps, websites, CRM, and backend systems, then unifies it into one customer profile. Your team segments customers based on each campaign needs.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Explore data platform capabilities
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Analytics
 
 
See where users drop off, which campaigns bring real revenue, and which channel performs better for each audience. Dashboards, reports, and funnel analysis, all in one place.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Learn about Analytics
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Journeys
 
 
A customer acts, Netmera responds. Automated, multi-step campaigns that branch and adapt in real time across every channel your customers use.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Build your journeys
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Segmentation
 
 
Go beyond basic demographics. Build audiences based on real-time behavior, profile attributes, and predictive data. The right message reaches the right person, every time.
 
 
 
 
 
 
See segmentation details
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Personalization
 
 
Every customer gets a different experience. From mobile push to web, including A/B tested content and personalized messaging across every channel your team manages.
 
 
 
 
 
 
How personalization works
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Omnichannel Messaging
 
 
Your customer opened the app, ignored the email, and converted on SMS. You only know that because everything runs through one platform. Mobile push, web messages, email, SMS, WhatsApp, in-app, and Live Activities, all connected to the same profile.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Explore all channels
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
AI
 
 
Predictive AI spots churn risk and purchase intent. Generative AI creates campaign creatives. Agentic AI builds targeting strategies, sends notifications, and recommends next steps. All three work together, so your team stays focused on growth.
 
 
 
 
 
 
AI features and capabilities

Build Your Marketing With an
 
 
 
Advanced Customer Data Platform
 
 
 
Collect and unify customer data from various touchpoints. Fully control and standardize the data you have at Netmera. Leverage CDP to seamlessly analyze and utilize data. Personalize all marketing efforts, enhance customer engagement, and deliver more tailored experiences.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
What is CDP (Customer Data Platform)?
 
 
 
A Customer Data Platform (CDP) is a software solution that collects, organizes, and analyzes customer data from various sources. It creates a unified and centralized customer database, allowing businesses to view their customers comprehensively across different channels and interactions.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Customer Data Enrichment
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Secure Data Integration & Data Storage
 
 
 Netmera CDP uses data from various sources, such as websites, mobile applications, CRM systems to create comprehensive customer data profiles or transfer email, GSM numbers, and attributes. This integration includes both online & offline interactions.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Unified Customer Profile
 
 
 
The data collected from various sources is organized into individual customer profiles, providing a unified and 360-degree view of each customer, including demographic information, purchase history, preferences, and behavior patterns.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Real-Time Customer Data Analytics & Insights
 
 
 Harness and analyze customer data in real time, get invaluable insights into user behavior, preferences, and interactions. Ensure that customer profiles are constantly refreshed and reflect the latest interactions and transactions. Make data-driven decisions for a sustained success.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Segmentation and Targeting
 
 
 You can segment customers based on various categories with Netmera. This segmentation allows businesses to create targeted marketing campaigns and personalized experiences for specific groups of customers using Netmera’s AI-based segmentation. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Privacy and Compliance 
 
 
 
Netmera CDP prioritizes data privacy and compliance in its design. We are here to assist businesses in adhering to regulations such as GDPR and KVKK, 
ensuring responsible customer data handling
. What important to us is your privacy.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Automated or Bulk Campaign Messaging 
 
 
 Reach a wide audience quickly and efficiently through various channels such as email, push notifications, in-app messages, or SMS. Leverage the power of Netmera CDP to utilize more relevant and timely marketing campaigns and improve customer engagement. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Create Unified Customer Profiles With Leveraging Data From Online and Offline Touchpoints
 
 
 
Gather data from all zero, first, and third-party data sources —websites, mobile applications, CRM systems, etc. Build in-depth customer profiles within an interconnected system using Netmera’s Web and Mobile SDKs.
Netmera CDP lets you combine event and profile data from online and offline sources through Web and Mobile SDKs and Rest API. Get real-time updates as your customers interact with your brand constantly and reflect the latest information.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Unified Profiles for Enhanced Personalization and Targeted Interactions
 
 
 
By providing a
 360-degree view
 of each customer, Netmera gives you a centralized and comprehensive compilation of customer data from various sources and interactions. The goal is to create a cohesive view of each customer, allowing businesses better to understand customer preferences, behaviors, and needs.
This unified profile enables more personalized and targeted interactions, improving customer experiences and more effective marketing strategies.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Leverage Real-Time Data for Automated User Segmentation
 
 
 
Create any segment you’d like or benefit from automatically generated predictive segments likely to churn or convert by
 Netmera’s AI technology.
By leveraging unified customer profiles, we empower businesses to deliver personalized content and cross-channel recommendations tailored to each audience. Netmera’s improved algorithms help you create AI-based predictive segments to customize, arrange, and target your campaigns for specific audiences. With the creation of targeted marketing campaigns, businesses can boost engagement and increase revenue.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Transform Your Marketing Campaigns with Seamless User Creation and Personalization
 
 
 Meet the targeted and efficient campaign management with Netmera CDP. Transform your approach to customer engagement by harnessing valuable data insights. Leverage the comprehensive customer data stored within the platform to personalize marketing messages, promotions, and content, resonating with individual preferences. Easily create segments based on complex user behaviors and user attributes.

Manage Cookie Consent
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
To provide the best experiences, we use technologies like cookies to store and/or access device information. Consenting to these technologies will allow us to process data such as browsing behavior or unique IDs on this site. Not consenting or withdrawing consent, may adversely affect certain features and functions.
 
 
 
 
 
Functional
 
 
 
 
Functional
 
 Always active 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
The technical storage or access is strictly necessary for the legitimate purpose of enabling the use of a specific service explicitly requested by the subscriber or user, or for the sole purpose of carrying out the transmission of a communication over an electronic communications network.
 
 
 
 
 
Preferences
 
 
 
Preferences
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
The technical storage or access is necessary for the legitimate purpose of storing preferences that are not requested by the subscriber or user.
 
 
 
 
 
Statistics
 
 
 
Statistics
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
The technical storage or access that is used exclusively for statistical purposes.
 
The technical storage or access that is used exclusively for anonymous statistical purposes. Without a subpoena, voluntary compliance on the part of your Internet Service Provider, or additional records from a third party, information stored or retrieved for this purpose alone cannot usually be used to identify you.
 
 
 
 
 
Marketing
 
 
 
Marketing
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
The technical storage or access is required to create user profiles to send advertising, or to track the user on a website or across several websites for similar marketing purposes.
